info.title: AFX DEX Info API
info.description:
Query endpoints for account data, orders, positions, trades, market data, and more.
All endpoints are `GET` requests. No signature required.

**Response format:**
```json
{ "code": 0, "message": "success", "data": { ... } }
```

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript

get.description: Get latest N kline candles, sorted by timestamp descending.
Get N klines before a given timestamp. Defaults to current time.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Upper bound timestamp (ms). Defaults to now.

get.description: Get all klines in a time range, sorted ascending.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Symbol code. Omit for all symbols.

get.description: Query a user's funding fee settlement history.

Returns vault info (TVL, APR, PnL). If `userAddress` is provided, also returns user position data.
When querying a parent vault, TVL/PnL/APR aggregate all sub-vaults.
Returns all vaults where user holds shares > 0.

200.description: List of vaults with user holdings

get.description: Returns user's full position info in a specific vault.

Returns all parent vaults (Active and Closed). Sub-vaults not listed.
TVL and APR aggregate sub-vault data.

200.description: Vault list with total locked value

get.description:
Returns vault TVL or PnL time-series data.

| interval | Range | Granularity |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| 24h | Last 24 hours | 1 hour |
| 7d | Last 7 days | 12 hours |
| 30d | Last 30 days | 1 day |
| all-time | All history | 1 month |
